## Samsung and SK Hynix Memory Inventories Crash Below 10 Days as AI Demand Triggers Historic Shortage, Per Report

Sub-10-day inventory at the two dominant HBM/DRAM suppliers, if confirmed, implies acute near-term pricing power and ASP upside — directly positive for memory-exposed names and a potential cost headwind for AI infrastructure buyers.

- A report cited by Wccftech claims Samsung and SK Hynix memory inventories have fallen below 10 days — characterized as an historically tight level.
- The shortage is explicitly attributed to AI-driven demand acceleration.
- Single-outlet sourcing means the specific figures should be treated as unconfirmed pending corroboration, but the directional read is consistent with broader memory tightness narratives.
